goal: Give administrators visible proof and complete control of VII URL redirects.

intent_model.literal_request: All promised addresses and redirects are missing from administration, and an edited item has no delete action.
intent_model.implied_outcome: The admin is the trustworthy operational view of every effective mapping, including provenance and safe lifecycle controls.
likely_rejections: Delete reactivates a hidden bundled rule.
The row disappears but returns after reload.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Inventory every effective bundled and managed 301/410 mapping rather than database rows alone.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Require full counts, server-side search and source visibility.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: Total mappings, active filters and the current page.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Search, edit, deactivate or delete one mapping.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Save or confirm deletion and observe the persisted refreshed result.
deferred_complexity: Audit event details remain stored for diagnostics.
preserved_depth: Source, status, public state, updater and timestamp remain available.

predictive_preflight.midpoint_requirement: Merged inventory helper passes representative precedence tests.
predictive_preflight.adversarial_requirement: Delete suppression, permissions, pagination, search and redirect-chain behavior are attacked.
predictive_preflight.effectiveness_requirement: Measure visible total against inventory stats and verify bounded rows.

facts.claim: The current admin API selects only vii_redirects rows with a limit of 500.
The current route exports GET and POST only.

assumptions.claim: Deleting a legacy mapping should suppress its former target while preserving an audit record.
assumptions.validation: Use an explicit deleted tombstone and verify worker fallback suppression.

in_scope: runtime suppression of deleted bundled mappings
out_of_scope: Changing destination choices in the approved legacy inventory
invariants: Active 301 and 410 behavior remains unchanged until edited
Admin authorization and same-origin mutation checks remain

requirements.statement: Show the complete effective redirect inventory with totals and source.
Allow an authorized editor to delete a mapping without hidden fallback restoration.
Keep changes attributable and persistent across reload.

acceptance_checks.setup: The bundled inventory and managed database rows exist.
acceptance_checks.action: Open or search the redirect administration.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The result and total are calculated from the merged effective inventory and each row identifies its source.
A clear no-results state appears without claiming the inventory is empty.

acceptance_checks.setup: An editor selects a bundled mapping.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The mapping stays deleted, the bundled fallback is suppressed and an audit event identifies the actor.

acceptance_checks.setup: A viewer or anonymous request attempts deletion.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The mutation is denied and the mapping remains unchanged.
The UI reports failure and keeps the row visible.
Untouched bundled mappings retain their previous behavior.

authorization_boundary: Local candidate implementation and verification only; deployment requires explicit instruction.
